requirements: English, per AGENTS.md engineering-output language law.
Every claim you write into CURRENT_STATE.md must be checkable in the repository today. If you cannot verify something, leave it out rather than carrying it forward.
Run only the test files named in test_baseline plus your new one and the privacy gate. Do not run the full pytest suite.
project/*.json is written only through scripts/project_queue.py.
Mechanical mismatches between this packet and the repository are settled against the repository and named in the SESSION_CLOSE; a RELAY_QUESTION is for a decision in conflict.
No emoji, no tool-identifying footer, no external URL in commits, the PR or code comments.

Commit early and often. SESSION_CLOSE names the index's record count, the word counts of both cold-start documents, the build-history records added, the backlog items closed, and the DLP re-anchoring.
risks: Inventing a supersession the prose does not state.
Appending to CURRENT_STATE.md instead of cutting, and blowing the budget.
Hand-editing project/*.json and losing the redaction and validation the script does.
Silencing the DLP test rather than re-anchoring it, which would turn a real scanner into decoration.

in: A generated successor index at docs/design/DECISION_RECORD_SUCCESSOR_INDEX.md, written by a new script (scripts/successor_index.py render, plus --check for the test): it parses every docs/design/*.md Status block, extracts the relations those blocks already state -- supersedes, amends, corrects, successor clause to, narrows -- and emits one table of (record, relation, target, date, one-line subject) plus, per target, the chain of everything that has touched it. Do not invent a relation that the prose does not state; a record whose Status names no relation appears in its own section as standalone. The index carries a line at the top saying it is generated and how to regenerate it.
A test (tests/test_successor_index.py) that the committed index matches a fresh render, so it cannot drift, and that every record naming a relation resolves to a document that exists.

Refresh CURRENT_STATE.md to the state of the repository as of this movement, inside its word budget: what the Java product does today end to end (discovery from the UI with candidate marking, device add and enrollment confirm, inventory collection with the cluster view, configuration collection with its index view and encrypted artefacts, Check Point gateway backup behind the pilot allowlist, local identity administration, the project plan screen), what is measured against real devices and what is still UNVERIFIED, what is deliberately disabled (restore, the scheduler), and the open Product Owner decisions. Cut what is no longer true rather than appending.
Refresh AI_HANDOVER.md inside its 300-word budget to point a fresh session at the right reading order for today, including the new successor index.

Refresh the project data through scripts/project_queue.py ONLY: add build-history records for the movements that merged on 2026-09-13 and 2026-09-14 (their movement ids are the relay filenames under relay/ and relay/archive/, and each merged pull request's title states what it delivered -- read them, do not guess), move roadmap current_build to the newest, and close every backlog item the merged work delivered. Where an item is partly delivered, note what remains instead of closing it.

Fix the one failing DLP case: the collision is prose in a committed relay file matching a secret-assignment pattern. Fix it at the scanner's fixture or anchor, not by deleting or rewording the relay record (relay files are history). State in the SESSION_CLOSE exactly what was re-anchored and why it is still a real scanner.
